# Pillar & Frame

> A video and copy studio in Marysville, Ohio, serving Union, Delaware, and Franklin counties. We film founder-led service businesses once, then write, shoot, and install every word, photo, and video the business needs across its website, Google Business Profile, and social platforms. The Foundation is the core offer. The Engine is the optional monthly retainer that keeps it running after.

## Location and service area
- Based in Marysville, Ohio. Service-area business, so no walk-in address.
- Serving Union, Delaware, and Franklin counties, including the Columbus metro.
- Capture days happen at the client's location.

## Services
- The Foundation (core offer, one-time $5,000 for the first ten clients, $7,500 after): one filming day, then a staged 90-day delivery. The Messaging Playbook lands in week two, the Google Business Profile goes live by day 30, and the full library is installed by day 90. Installed for the client, not handed over. https://pillarandframe.com/
- The Engine (optional retainer after The Foundation, $2,500 per month, three-month minimum): we film once a month and turn it into a month of videos, posts, captions, and graphics in the client's voice, with coaching built in. https://pillarandframe.com/engine

## What makes the work different
- Real Human Origin: real people on camera, verbatim quotes, no stock imagery, no AI-generated copy or imagery. If a thing did not happen, it does not go in the work.
- Every deliverable is installed where it belongs rather than handed over as a folder.
- Fifteen years of production experience, from local shops to Fortune 500 clients, in more than ten countries.

## Proof
- Case studies: https://pillarandframe.com/work (Frontier Technologies, Memorial Health)

## Book
- Free 30-minute strategy call, written report in 48 hours: https://pillarandframe.com/book

City Spotlight Ohio (https://cityspotlightohio.com) is a Pillar & Frame project: a documentary magazine about local businesses in Central Ohio towns.
